instructions.name: accept_ownership
docs: Pending owner takes over; clears `confirmed` so prior liquidation consent dies with the old owner.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Claim yield dividends for one listed asset.
`amount == u64::MAX` claims the full accrued balance; otherwise `min(amount, claimable)`.
Tip (`claim_tip_bps`) is paid to `payer`; remainder to `holder`.

accounts.name: tip_asset_ata
docs: Caller tip ATA (EVM `msg.sender` tip from `claimTipBps`). Same as holder ATA when self-claiming.

instructions.name: claim_all
docs: EVM `claimAll(locker)`. Remaining per listed mint: vault PDA + holder/payer ATAs are bound
on-chain (`["vault", mint]`, ATA(holder), ATA(payer)).

accounts.name: treasury_vault
docs: In-program treasury inventory vault (EVM `Treasury` balance for this asset).
Created on `set_feed` list alongside the asset vault.

instructions.name: get_assets
docs: EVM `getAssets`.

instructions.name: get_lockers
docs: EVM `getLockers(fromId, toId)`. Remaining: escrow PDA per locker in the slice.

instructions.name: get_redeemables
docs: EVM `getRedeemables` — redeemable basket while liquidation is open.
Remaining: `[asset_config, vault_ata]` × N.

instructions.name: get_lockers_data
docs: EVM GRAI `getLockersData(fromId, toId)`: bound lockers plus `previewClaimAll`.
Remaining: `[referrer] × M`, `[escrow] × M`, `[asset_config] × N`, then
`[position]` locker-major (`M` in `[from, to)`, `N` listed mints).
Escrow / position PDAs may be empty.

instructions.name: get_voters
docs: EVM `getVoters(fromId, toId)`. Remaining: escrow PDA per voter in the slice.

instructions.name: poach
docs: Purchase `locker`'s affiliate slot for `value + l1_value` GRAI.

instructions.name: preview_bribe
docs: Dynamic bribe ask for `grai_amount` of `voter`'s vote: `(bribe_amount, premium, discount)`
in `settlement_asset` units. Exactly one of `premium` / `discount` is non-zero.

instructions.name: preview_claim
docs: EVM `previewClaim`. `amount == u64::MAX` = full pending.

instructions.name: preview_claim_all
docs: EVM `previewClaimAll`. Remaining: `[asset_config, position]` × N.

instructions.name: preview_deposit
docs: EVM `previewDeposit` → `(value, grai_out)`.

instructions.name: preview_poach
docs: Quote the current referral-slot purchase price and seller.

instructions.name: preview_redeem
docs: EVM `previewRedeem`. Remaining: `[asset_config, vault_ata]` × N.

instructions.name: preview_unlock
docs: EVM `previewUnlock`. Pass `timestamp == 0` to use the cluster clock.

instructions.name: set_feed
docs: EVM `setFeed` waterfall: list / pause-only / replace-while-paused / delist (`FEED_NONE`).
`paused` mirrors `Feed.paused`. Pass System Program as `price_feed` for delist (must be paused).
`moved_asset_config` is the swapped tail config on mid-list delist; pass `asset_config` otherwise.

accounts.name: asset_config
docs: Seeds: `[AssetConfig::SEED, asset_mint]`.

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: Seeds: `[AssetConfig::VAULT_SEED, asset_mint]`.

accounts.name: moved_asset_config
docs: Pass `asset_config` when unused (list / update / last asset).

instructions.name: transfer_ownership
docs: Propose a new owner (EVM `Ownable2Step.transferOwnership`).
Pass `Pubkey::default()` to cancel a pending handoff; `owner` is unchanged until accept.

fields.name: acc_share
docs: Dividend index per unvoted locked GRAI, scaled by 1e18 (EVM `TotalPosition.accShare`).

fields.name: total_claimable
docs: Vault inventory reserved for locker claims (excluded from redeem / revive).

fields.name: pyth_feed_id
docs: Pyth push price id (EVM `Feed.data`). Zero for custom / Chainlink / legacy Pyth.

types.name: BribeQuote
docs: Return shape of the `preview_bribe` view.

types.name: ClaimAllQuote
docs: Return shape of `preview_claim_all`.

types.name: Config
docs: Yield split, bribe premium, liquidation quorum, unlock penalty, and timing.
Mirrors the EVM `Config`. `dividend_cut_bps + treasury_cut_bps` MUST sum to `BPS` (10_000).
Yield cuts are immutable after `initialize`.

fields.name: dividend_cut_bps
docs: Share of distributed yield / bribe cut pool paid as dividends on unvoted locked GRAI, in bps.

fields.name: treasury_cut_bps
docs: Share of distributed yield / bribe cut pool sent to the in-program treasury vault, in bps.

fields.name: revenue_share_bps
docs: Affiliate slice of treasury income allocated on claim (`claimed * this / dividend_cut`).
EVM default `5_55` (~5.55% of yield → affiliates).

fields.name: claim_tip_bps
docs: Share of each `claim` paid to the caller as a tip, in bps of claimed amount (max 5%).

fields.name: bribe_premium_bps
docs: Max |ask adjustment| for dynamic bribes, in bps of book value.

fields.name: quorum_bps
docs: Voted / supply needed to open liquidation, in bps.

fields.name: unlock_penalty_bps
docs: Flat unlock fee in bps of unlocked GRAI (EVM `unlockPenaltyBps`).

fields.name: liquidation_period
docs: Delay after liquidation opens before `redeem` is allowed.

fields.name: redeem_period
docs: Extra window after `liquidation_period` before liquidation can be closed via `revive`.

types.name: DepositQuote
docs: Return shape of `preview_deposit`.

types.name: Escrow
docs: Per-user lock + liquidation vote escrow (GRAI held by the GRAI vault while locked).

fields.name: amount
docs: Actively locked GRAI (max voting capacity; `amount - voted` earns dividends).

fields.name: voted
docs: GRAI counted toward liquidation quorum (<= amount).

fields.name: voted_at
docs: Timestamp of the latest `vote`.

fields.name: locker_id
docs: Index of this account in `grai_state.lockers`.

fields.name: voter_id
docs: Index of this account in `grai_state.voters`.

types.name: EscrowView
docs: EVM `Escrow` view row for `getLockers` / `getVoters`.

fields.name: owner
docs: Protocol admin (EVM `Ownable.owner`).

fields.name: pending_owner
docs: Two-step handoff target (EVM `Ownable2Step.pendingOwner`). Default = none.

fields.name: beneficiar
docs: Protocol fee recipient for the non-affiliate slice of claim-time treasury income
(EVM `Treasury.beneficiar`).

fields.name: settlement_asset
docs: Asset used for bribe payments (EVM `settlementAsset`). `Pubkey::default()` means unset.

fields.name: total_locked
docs: Total escrowed GRAI (`total_locked - total_voted` is the dividend base).

fields.name: confirmed
docs: Owner consent bit for 2-of-2 liquidation open (EVM `confirmed`).

fields.name: royalty_bps
docs: Secondary-sale royalty in bps (EVM ERC-2981 `royaltyBps`); receiver = locker.

fields.name: affiliate_levels
docs: Active affiliate referrer levels (`affiliate_share_bps[0..affiliate_levels]`).

fields.name: affiliate_share_bps
docs: Per-level split of claim-time revenue share (bps; active prefix sums to 10_000).

fields.name: lockers
docs: Accounts with an open lock (`escrow.amount > 0`). EVM `lockers`.

fields.name: voters
docs: Accounts with an open liquidation vote (`escrow.voted > 0`).

fields.name: referrers
docs: Treasury-bound lockers in mint order (EVM ERC-721 enumerable / `getLockersData`).

types.name: LockerDataView
docs: EVM GRAI `LockerData` (+ `nft_mint` for Metaplex cashflow NFT).
`assets` / `claimable` match `preview_claim_all` (listed-mint order; amount may be 0).

fields.name: owner_of
docs: Current NFT holder when known; default if not passed / not minted.

types.name: PoachQuote
docs: Return shape of `preview_poach`.

types.name: Position
docs: Per-account, per-asset ledger (EVM `Position`).
Locker dividends use `debt` / `claimable` vs `AssetConfig.acc_share`.
Custodian `distribute` increments `yielded`.

fields.name: debt
docs: Debt vs the asset dividend index (MasterChef checkpoint).

fields.name: claimable
docs: Dividends accrued but not yet claimed (`claim` may take a partial amount).

fields.name: yielded
docs: Cumulative yield distributed by this account as custodian.

types.name: RedeemQuote
docs: Return shape of `preview_redeem` / `get_redeemables`.

types.name: ReferralBookView
docs: EVM `ITreasury.ReferralBook`.

types.name: Referrer
docs: Sticky referrer tree + Metaplex cashflow NFT for a locker (EVM Treasury three-layer slot).
- `referrer` = sticky tree link (`referrerOf`); moved only by first `mint` / `poach`.
- `nft_mint` = Metaplex 1/1 cashflow NFT (`ownerOf`); OTC via ordinary NFT transfer.
- `value` / `l1_value` / `l2_value` = deposit books keyed by locker identity.

fields.name: referrer
docs: Sticky referrer locker (EVM `ReferralBook.referrer`); `Pubkey::default()` means unbound.

fields.name: nft_mint
docs: Treasury cashflow NFT mint (`["treasury-nft", locker]`); default = not minted yet.

fields.name: value
docs: This locker's cumulative deposited USD value.

fields.name: l1_value
docs: Cumulative value directly referred by this wallet.

fields.name: l2_value
docs: Cumulative value referred through its direct affiliates.

types.name: UnlockQuote
docs: Return shape of `preview_unlock`.
